briefings.title: FedEx CEO Raj Subramaniam & Alphabet Pres. Ruth Porat at Silicon Valley & The World | Semafor
briefings.tldr: Alphabet President Ruth Porat and FedEx CEO Raj Subramaniam argued that massive AI infrastructure investments are justified by measurable economic returns—from boosting national GDP and small-business revenues to orchestrating $1.9 trillion in global supply chain inefficiencies—provided tech and logistics leaders secure local community buy-in and build on proprietary data foundations.

briefings.title: FedEx CEO Raj Subramaniam: We are undergoing a tremendous transformation
briefings.tldr: FedEx is executing a fundamental "One FedEx" transformation to transition from a physical logistics provider to a data-driven supply chain orchestrator, projecting a 13–14% operating income CAGR through 2027 despite modest revenue growth.
